column1: # ONE table, run by every language mirror so they cannot drift:
# Tab-separated.  Column 1 is the case kind; remaining columns depend on kind.
# Empty fields are written as empty strings between tabs (trailing tabs matter).
# The group is ASCII digits, at most 9 of them (it must fit an int); leading
# zeros are read as decimal.  A longer group used to throw std::out_of_range in
# C++; a non-ASCII digit was a group in Python only.
# _D<lag><dims> names a FEATURE space over the waveforms of the token without it, so a
# Shared .spk/.res for a lag token falls back to that waveform token before standard.
# Exact files still win; MethodSpecific types stay strict; an opaque token is not stripped.
# When nothing exists the path offered for writing is the WAVEFORM token's, so a writer
# (Klusters Save As) never creates a second, _D-named copy of the waveforms.
# _D<lag><dims>: the lag feature space fiber-session emits under --feat-lag.
# Suffixes peel from the RIGHT, so a token may carry both a kind and a lag.
# NOTE: lag/dims are NOT columns here -- this table is four-wide and widening it
# changes the reader in all four mirrors.  These rows pin the FAMILY and KIND,
# which is what isStderivMethod and every resolve path depend on; the lag/dims
# values themselves are covered by the C++ unit test until the table is widened.
# malformed suffixes stay opaque - the whole token is the family
# An unknown, repeated or malformed suffix makes the WHOLE token opaque even
# after a suffix has been peeled.  (C++ and ndm_custody used to keep the part
# peeled so far: stderiv_X1_D34 -> family stderiv_X1, lag 3.)
# ...but a part that is not _<char><digits> at all only ends the peeling.
# An order longer than 9 digits is malformed (it would overflow a 32-bit int in
# C++), so the whole token is opaque; 9 digits is the longest order accepted.
# -- waveform_token: the waveform space of a feature-space token -------------
# A _D<lag><dims> token names features over the waveforms of the token without
# it; anything without a well-formed lag is returned unchanged (never rewritten).
# -- drops_last: does a spatial order leave a channel PCA drops? -------------
# 1 and 3 are rank deficient; 4's root output is redundant; 5 drops by
# -- stderiv domain: family test, NOT a "stderiv" prefix test -----------------
# -- the new tokens parse through the existing naming paths -------------------
# ── resolve_any: the ONE physical copy of a Shared artifact (res, spk) ───────
# resolve() walks a fixed method -> standard -> untagged list and so misses a
# copy written under any other token, including every suffixed one -- which no
# fixed list can enumerate.  resolve_any scans instead.  Same columns as resolve:
# preferred absent -> fall through the standard/stderiv/sdiff order
# THE POINT: a suffixed token no fixed list names is still found by scanning
# a known token still beats an arbitrary one
# several other tagged copies: the first in byte order of the file name wins
# (not the filesystem's listing order, nor the locale's collation: 'S' < 's')
# a dotted middle part is not a bare token and is never resolved to
# untagged legacy name is the last resort, after every tagged copy
# a longer stage tag is NOT a method token and must not be resolved to
# nothing present -> not found, path points at where the preferred copy would be
# group is part of the match: a copy for another group must not be returned
